ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels concentrated centrally and 30% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels localized at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity region forms a large contiguous macro-blob. Two high-intensity contiguous regions are mapped to the distal lobes: a larger white patch on the left lobe with linear dark intrusions, and a smaller, more fragmented white patch on the right lobe tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a sharp vertex; estimated angle of 40-50 degrees relative to the lobe mid-lines.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular peaks and valleys across both lobes. Left lobe exhibits medium-amplitude serrations. Right lobe displays a significant high-amplitude concave indentation (notch) on its inner trailing edge, isolated from the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curvature of the trailing edge transitioning into convex outer margins that taper toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast white clusters (approx. 5-10 pixels in diameter) visible along the leading edge of the left lobe and upper-right margin of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant series of at least four parallel, dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white pigmentation on the distal left lobe; shorter, horizontal linear disruptions observed on the white patch of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A deep, irregular concave loss of tissue on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe, distinct from natural serration patterns.
